# Artifact Relay

Artifact Relay publishes long AI-agent Markdown and standalone HTML output as private, mobile-friendly web pages. It can run self-hosted with Docker or as an isolated managed instance. The library is private by default; optional artifact-scoped share links are revocable and can expire.

## Canonical links

- Product: https://artifact-relay.lok-labs.com/
- Self-host first artifact guide: https://artifact-relay.lok-labs.com/self-host/
- Credential boundaries for secure agent publishing: https://artifact-relay.lok-labs.com/guides/secure-agent-publishing/
- Source and self-hosting: https://github.com/eloktev/artifact-relay
- Hermes Agent plugin: https://github.com/eloktev/hermes-artifact-relay
- Managed connection flow: https://relay.lok-labs.com/
- Latest release: https://github.com/eloktev/artifact-relay/releases/latest
- Security policy: https://github.com/eloktev/artifact-relay/blob/main/SECURITY.md

## Core capabilities

- Publish sanitized Markdown or sandboxed standalone HTML through a bearer-authenticated API.
- Read artifacts in a password-protected mobile-friendly library.
- Group and filter artifacts by human-readable topics.
- Create optional scoped share links without exposing the private library.
- Install a Hermes Agent plugin that provides artifact_publish and artifact_read tools.
